title: Sprite Library: Kept Year Faces joins, 58 packs now
html:
Kept Year Faces is now in the Sprite Library: 60 RPG dialogue portraits, 12 characters of one fantasy village, each in five expressions (neutral, happy, sad, angry and surprised). The Library now holds 58 packs, worth $431.42 bought one by one, for $19.99. If you own it, download it again from your itch.io library: it is in kept-year-portraits/kept-year-faces/.

{{IMG:shot_3_inside_villagers_and_farm.png}}

  • 60 portrait PNGs at 96x96 (native, never scaled) and one sheet, cut by frames.json.
  • 12 RPG Maker MZ face sheets, one per character: face index 0 neutral, 1 happy, 2 sad, 3 angry, 4 surprised.
  • The cast: village girl, old pilgrim, young boy, carpenter, grandmother, miller's daughter, old hedger, smith boy, young officer, captain, midwife and carter.

It is new here first: it has no page of its own yet, so for now the Library is the place to get it. The portraits were generated by PixelLab, a generative AI pixel-art model, on a paid plan whose terms permit commercial use: each neutral bust first, then the other expressions by repainting only the face of that bust (two happy faces are separate laughing portraits). They were finished on the pixel grid and palette-locked by code.

Every new CSAF sprite pack joins this page on its launch day, at no cost to anyone who owns it. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.
